reference_definition.const: Matched vertical gaps and SOC are evaluated at each S0 geometry. For energy transfer use consistent adiabatic excitation energies: delta_TTET=E_T1(rubrene)-E_T1(sensitizer); negative is energetically downhill. Rubrene annihilation balance=2E_T1(rubrene)-E_S1(rubrene); nonnegative is an energetic prerequisite. These are not rates or quantum yields.

validation_boundary: Format only. Raw outputs, controls, arithmetic and state identity must pass the scientific evaluator. A bounded failure is accepted for reporting, never as scientific completion.
